en: Color-tinted historic postcard showing a market square bordered by buildings with steep red-tiled roofs and rows of carefully trimmed trees forming an arcade along the street. In the left foreground stands a tall stone column with a sculptural top, surrounded by a balustrade and chains. Two children pose in the open square in the front. The caption at the top reads in German about the market square in Königsberg in the Egerland.
